Euphorbia Heterodoxa.



Alveloz. N. O. Euphorbiacæ. A soft resin, insoluble in alcohol or water.
        Trituration.



Clinical. ─   Cancer.



Characteristics. ─   The resin has been used
        allopathically as an external application in cases of cancer, and has produced the most
        terrible pains. Conversely in homœopathic attenuations it has been found to alleviate the   burning pains of cancer  , which is the keynote for its employment.
        Compare   Euphorbium  .
